fresh_jules_prompt:
You are the PRIMARY CODING AGENT for TASK-0005 Movie Studio.

The verified lifecycle, provider-registry, and durable ShotPlan increments are already on the base branch. Continue Phase 2 only. Implement the next narrow offline increment: durable per-shot continuity bindings tied to the Movie Bible. Do not start Phase 3 provider execution.

Required behavior:
- Extend MovieBible with migration-safe entity maps for costumes and props, following the same strict entity-map shape as characters, voices, and locations. Older structurally valid checkpoints that omit costumes/props must restore with empty maps.
- Add a frozen ShotContinuityBinding record persisted per shot. It must bind: shot_id, bible_revision, character_ids, voice_ids, location_id, costume_ids, prop_ids, and reference_asset_versions.
- Use deterministic immutable collection types in memory and deterministic JSON-compatible serialized forms. Reject duplicates inside any ID/reference collection.
- ProductionLedger must persist a shot_continuity_bindings map keyed by shot_id, migration-safe empty for older checkpoints.
- Add add_shot_continuity_binding(binding) with fail-closed validation: existing shot; key/embedded shot identity match; bible_revision is positive integer and equals the current MovieBible revision at binding time; every referenced character/voice/location/costume/prop exists in the MovieBible; all IDs/reference versions are non-empty strings; location_id may be empty only when explicitly represented as no location; strict type validation; exact duplicate registration may be idempotent but conflicting replacement must be rejected.
- A voice reference must not be accepted unless the same binding includes at least one character, so voice continuity cannot float independently of a character.
- Persist/restore/validate exactly. Corrupted map keys, dangling entity references, duplicate IDs, malformed types, stale/non-positive bible revision, and unknown fields must fail closed.
- Add a deterministic continuity_binding_digest helper derived only from the canonical serialized binding fields. Same binding => same digest; any field/reference/version/revision change => different digest.
- Do NOT yet freeze planning or change generation authorization behavior. This increment is continuity state only.
- Update the JSON schema to match the exact persisted representation.
- Add focused deterministic tests covering migration-safe MovieBible restore, costumes/props validation, happy-path shot continuity binding, unknown/dangling references, duplicate collection entries, voice-without-character rejection, stale/wrong bible revision rejection, idempotent duplicate vs conflicting replacement, round-trip/schema alignment, corrupted checkpoint rejection, and digest stability/change detection.

Strict scope:
- Modify ONLY these three files:
  1. scripts/movie_studio_core__created_by_chatgpt__model_gpt_5_6_sol__task_TASK_0005.py
  2. tests/test_movie_studio_core__created_by_chatgpt__model_gpt_5_6_sol__task_TASK_0005.py
  3. schemas/movie_studio_production_state__created_by_chatgpt__model_gpt-5.6-sol__task_TASK-0005.schema.json
- Do NOT create helper/scratch/plan/migration/report/wrapper/doc/review/workflow/dispatch/memory/monitor/provenance files.
- Do NOT weaken, delete, skip, rename, or move existing tests out of discovery.
- Preserve ShotPlan ordering/duration/digest behavior, all pre-existing MovieBible semantics, lifecycle/provider registry, zero-spend authorization, idempotency/retry/stale-callback protections, QA/canonicalization, and checkpoint fail-closed behavior.
- Run python -m py_compile on the core, parse the schema, and run the complete deterministic Movie Studio suite verbosely. Repair failures autonomously within the three-file scope.
